name: HTTP Response
description: Sends an HTTP response back to the client that called a Route endpoint.

inputs.name: statusCode
inputs.label: Status Code
inputs.helpText: HTTP status code to return to the calling client.

inputs.name: responseBody
inputs.label: Response Body
inputs.helpText: Content to return to the client. Accepts a variable (e.g. {{nodes.agent_1.result}}) or literal JSON / text.

inputs.name: headers
inputs.label: Response Headers (JSON)
inputs.helpText: Custom HTTP headers to include in the response.
